title: Lawful Basis for Processing
requirement: The document must explicitly state the lawful legal basis relied upon for collecting and processing personal data.

title: Conditions for Consent
requirement: The document must explain that consent can be freely given, specific, informed, and can be withdrawn by the data subject at any time.

title: Right to Access
requirement: The document must state that individuals have the right to request access to and obtain copies of their personal data.

title: Right to Erasure
requirement: The document must describe the individual's right to request the deletion or removal of their personal data without undue delay.

title: Data Breach Notification
requirement: The document must mention procedures for notifying supervisory authorities and affected individuals within 72 hours in the event of a personal data breach.

title: Data Minimization
requirement: The document must specify that personal data collected is adequate, relevant, and strictly limited to what is necessary for the stated processing purposes.

title: Purpose Limitation
requirement: The document must clearly state the specific, explicit, and legitimate purposes for which personal data is collected and processed.

title: Data Retention Period
requirement: The document must specify the storage periods for personal data or the explicit criteria used to determine how long data will be retained.

title: Data Protection Officer Contact Information
requirement: The document must provide clear contact details for the designated Data Protection Officer (DPO) or privacy compliance team.

title: Cross-Border Data Transfer Safeguards
requirement: The document must disclose whether personal data is transferred outside the European Economic Area and detail the safeguards applied for such transfers.
